My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?

When tracking shows "delivered" but you haven't received the package, it may have been left in an unexpected location or could arrive shortly after the delivery scan. Here's what to check:



Look around your delivery address (front door, side door, back door, garage, mailroom, porch, or other secure locations)


Check with household members, neighbors, or building staff


Allow up to 24–48 hours after the delivered scan for late-arriving deliveries



Also, some orders ship in multiple boxes with separate tracking numbers — one package may have been delivered while another is still in transit.
